summary: Restored os.Setenv("NCCPL_LEARN_SURFACE", "mcp") in the MCP entrypoint.
reason: `mcp-sync` regenerates cmd/<cli>-pp-mcp/main.go and drops this line. internal/store/events.go defaults surface detection to "cli" when the variable is unset, and the command-mirror tools launch the companion CLI with the server's environment, so without it every MCP invocation is recorded as CLI activity and the per-surface learning statistics are wrong. Re-apply after any future mcp-sync.
validated_outcome: go build/vet clean, go test ./... 0 failures; grep confirms the Setenv is present and events.go reads the same constant.
